Derrick's Rock Climbing Budget Plan

Initial Costs (One-time purchases):
- Climbing Shoes: $80 - $150
- Harness: $50 - $100
- Carabiners (set of 5-8): $40 - $80
- Helmet: $40 - $80
- Ropes (if buying for home gym/training): $150 - $300 per rope (Note: Most climbers rent or buy access to gyms/crags rather than owning full-length ropes initially due to storage and maintenance costs. If Derrick is buying for a home wall, include this. If not, this cost is $0.)
- Total Initial Estimate (excluding ropes): $210 - $410
- Total Initial Estimate (including one rope): $360 - $710

Ongoing Costs:
- Gym Membership (if applicable): $30 - $60 per month
- Chalk and Chalk Bag: $10 - $20 every few months
- Shoe Resoling: $30 - $50 every 6-12 months depending on usage
- Replacement Gear (carabiners, harness wear): $20 - $50 annually
- Total Annual Ongoing Estimate (with gym): $360 - $720+
- Total Annual Ongoing Estimate (without gym, outdoor only): $60 - $120

Most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat: Banana
